buildSteps.title: Design and simulate
buildSteps.detail: Engineers model the ring in CAD, simulate how light travels through finger tissue, and check that the sensors sit firmly against the skin for different finger sizes.

buildSteps.title: Machine the shell
buildSteps.detail: A titanium blank is machined or additively manufactured into a ring shape, then polished and coated so it is skin-safe and durable.

buildSteps.title: Assemble the sensor module
buildSteps.detail: LEDs, photodiodes and optical barriers are placed on a small flexible printed circuit board and glued into the inner surface of the ring.

buildSteps.title: Build the electronics
buildSteps.detail: The microcontroller, Bluetooth chip, analog front end and a tiny lithium-polymer battery are soldered onto the main circuit board.

buildSteps.title: Pot and seal
buildSteps.detail: The electronics are encapsulated in resin or epoxy and the ring is sealed to withstand sweat, hand-washing and everyday knocks.

buildSteps.title: Calibrate
buildSteps.detail: Each unit is tested against reference instruments so that heart rate, oxygen estimates and motion readings are consistent from ring to ring.

buildSteps.title: Flash firmware and pair
buildSteps.detail: Production firmware is loaded, and the ring is paired with a test phone to confirm Bluetooth range and data transfer.

buildSteps.title: Final quality control and packaging
buildSteps.detail: A last check of battery, seal and sensors is done before the ring, charger and sizing kit are packed.

prerequisites.why: They shine light into the finger and measure reflected light to detect each pulse.
It lets the ring send data to a phone for days on a very small battery.
They pack enough energy into a few cubic centimetres to run the sensors and radio.
Algorithms can estimate sleep stages from heart rate, motion and temperature, but they are not as accurate as a clinical sleep study.
Some wearables have cleared atrial fibrillation detection, but continuous medical-grade monitoring from a ring is not yet routine.

pathway.milestone: Regulatory-cleared atrial fibrillation and blood-oxygen trend alerts
pathway.unlocks: Early warning for heart-rhythm problems outside a clinic.
Daily cardiovascular monitoring without a bulky arm cuff.

pathway.milestone: Non-invasive continuous glucose and hydration sensing
pathway.unlocks: Metabolic and hydration tracking from a finger ring, if the chemistry can be made reliable.
